 Order

This is first bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.241/2024, dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Agar, District Agar Malwa (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and sections 3/4,
5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. It is alleged that applicant abducted the minor girl and also sexually exploited the prosecutrix.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that prosecutrix remain with the applicant for more than 8 months and she was a consenting party.
The applicant is in jail since 18.06.2024 and conclusion of trial may take time.
In these circumstances, the applicant be released on bail.
4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail and submits that prosecutrix was minor at the time of the incident.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view that the facts of the present case and also the age of the prosecutrix which is more than 17 years on the date of incident, the application is allowed, this Court is of the considered view that the applicant is entitled for grant of Laxman Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83026602/
1 bail.
